review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample: 15 targets. None could be checked against a source text, because the five cited books have no legal copy and most sample targets carry no locator, so they were checked by computation: every Check and numerical value was recomputed. The automatic checks all pass. The dependency check reports 171 roadmaps, 1990 edges and 0 problems. Suggested.lean, elaborated again at this head, gives 14 sorry warnings and nothing else, and all 14 theorems survive the one-tactic probe. 106 library declarations were checked by #check at the pins, and the cross-roadmap citations resolve on main. The single P2 finding: ZeroFreeRightOf and its API (9.2) duplicate QuasiRiemannHypothesis §1.1 at its open head 3817fa7, which is earlier in the merge order and is not cited.
